name: text-utf16
algorithm: UTF-8 to UTF-16 (encode) or UTF-16 back to UTF-8 (decode) with each language's standard conversion, reps passes over generated text of mib MiB (splitmix64 from seed, 37.5 percent of the scalars outside ASCII, README.md); decode converts one unit buffer made once before the passes.

skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; the conversion's arithmetic cannot overflow

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own algorithm; the checksum (the result's length and one unit or byte a pass) checks that every column converted the same text
notes: Idiomatic standard library (plan/06-m6.md 4.1). encode: Mk std.text.ToUtf16 into an arena Reset per pass; C <uchar.h> mbrtoc16 one character a call into a malloc'd buffer of n units; Rust str::encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<u16>>(); Zig std.unicode.utf8ToUtf16LeAlloc; Go utf16.Encode([]rune(s)). decode: Mk std.text.FromUtf16; C c16rtomb one unit a call into a malloc'd buffer of 3 bytes a unit; Rust String::from_utf16; Zig std.unicode.utf16LeToUtf8Alloc; Go string(utf16.Decode(u)). Go has no direct UTF-8 to UTF-16 function, so the []rune step is part of its idiom both ways.

C on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc: the UCRT's mbrtoc16 and c16rtomb convert UTF-8 whatever the locale (Microsoft's documentation of both); on Linux the program sets a UTF-8 locale (C.UTF-8, else en_US.UTF-8) and stops if there is none.
